description: Check a reference list for problems: missing required fields for the entry type, bad page ranges, titles that are not capitalized, invalid DOIs, odd years and repeated keys. Each issue names the entry key, the field and a plain message. Example: an @article with no journal field gives an issue with the rule missing-field and the field journal. Pass the whole list as text so repeated keys can be found.

format.description: The format of the text. Defaults to auto, which looks at the text to decide.

text.description: The reference list as text: BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON.

name: lint_entries
title: Lint entries
